exposure: Stage of labor at time of cesarean section
cohort: 495 mothers who underwent cesarean section at Bahir Dar city public specialized hospitals, Bahir Dar, Ethiopia from January 1, 2020 to December 30, 2020
finding: The study found a high maternal complication rate (44.04%) associated with cesarean section, with living in a rural setting, having obstetric complications, previous cesarean scar, emergency surgeries, operation done in the second stage of labor, and prolonged surgery duration as significant predictors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section done at the second stage of labor was significantly associated with maternal complications (AOR = 4.358, 95%CI: 1.841-10.317).
